stories.h: Oil crosses $100 as the US-Iran war intensifies
stories.w: Brent and US crude pushed above $100 a barrel after new attacks threatened shipping and supply, raising fuel and transport costs across the North American economy.

stories.h: US-Canada trade war expands from tariffs to outright import bans
stories.w: Washington barred Canadian dairy products, motorcycles and most alcohol after Ottawa imposed retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion of US goods, escalating disruption across a deeply integrated market.

stories.h: Trump promises $5,000 payments if Republicans retain Congress
stories.w: At the Republican midterm convention, the president tied an extraordinary cash pledge to continued GOP control while defending the Iran war, making both central election issues.

stories.h: North Carolina begins restoring 60 square kilometres of peatland
stories.w: Scientists and investors are rewetting damaged peat to curb carbon emissions and rebuild habitat, testing whether private finance can protect a major natural carbon store.

stories.h: Washington shifts toward joint Latin American anti-drug operations
stories.w: Marco Rubio said the US is seeking operations aligned with partner-country laws while preserving the option of lethal maritime strikes, after at least 230 deaths in 69 boat attacks.

stories.h: Brazil's chief justice intervenes in a damaging Supreme Court feud
stories.w: Chief Justice Edson Fachin suspended conflicting rulings by two rival justices, restoring the federal police chief as institutional turmoil becomes an issue before next month's presidential election.

stories.h: Colombia's new government deepens security alignment with Washington
stories.w: President Abelardo de la Espriella joined the Americas Counter Cartels Coalition and expanded cooperation on drugs and migration, reversing the strained relationship under Gustavo Petro.

stories.h: US forces sink another Ecuadorian vessel in the Pacific
stories.w: Southern Command said the vessel supported Los Choneros drug trafficking; people aboard were removed for transfer to Ecuador before the boat was destroyed.

stories.h: Ukraine demands stronger action after another deadly Russian barrage
stories.w: Russian attacks again killed civilians, including at a checkpoint near Moldova, as Kyiv argued that allied pressure has not matched the escalating assault on populated areas.

stories.h: UK air-traffic failure drives cancellations above 2,000
stories.w: A technical failure at Nats disrupted hundreds of thousands of passengers; the transport secretary ordered an investigation and an independent resilience review.

stories.h: Europe weighs a major expansion of sovereign space capacity
stories.w: Industry leaders meeting in Paris pressed for launch and satellite investment as dependence on Starlink and US providers becomes a strategic vulnerability; the next EU budget may allocate about €60 billion.

stories.h: Merz cancels Trump call after praise for the AfD
stories.w: Germany's chancellor cancelled a scheduled call after Trump celebrated the far-right AfD's election result, sharpening tensions over migration, Ukraine and democratic politics.

stories.h: More than a third of Sudan's health facilities are out of service
stories.w: MSF says aid cuts are pushing millions toward a shrinking number of clinics while 19.5 million people face crisis-level hunger and the UN response remains badly underfunded.

stories.h: Gambia declares rolling blackouts a national-security emergency
stories.w: After violent protests over outages lasting up to 48 hours, President Adama Barrow promised 24 megawatts of new generation by October and a future 50-megawatt solar plant.

stories.h: Kenya grants temporary amnesty to undocumented East African migrants
stories.w: The registration window followed an order targeting foreign-run small businesses and reports of harassment, affecting a regional community whose bloc formally guarantees freedom of movement.

stories.h: Gunmen kill a police officer and abduct five teachers in Cameroon
stories.w: The attack on a training centre in the anglophone Northwest came as separatists sought to disrupt the school year in a decade-long conflict that has displaced hundreds of thousands.

stories.h: Bangladesh measles outbreak passes 1,000 child deaths
stories.w: Health officials reported 187,484 childhood infections and acknowledged that roughly four million children were missed by the vaccination campaign, leaving dangerous gaps in immunity.

stories.h: Indonesia becomes the world's largest source of wildfire emissions
stories.w: Fires released an estimated 19.7 million tonnes in one week as extreme El Niño conditions drove the worst season in 11 years and hazardous air spread across Kalimantan and Sumatra.

stories.h: China and the Philippines trade warnings over South China Sea claims
stories.w: Beijing accused Manila of provoking trouble after the Philippine defence chief invoked the 2016 arbitration ruling rejecting China's sweeping claims over a crucial trade route.

stories.h: India prepares its first uncrewed Gaganyaan orbital mission
stories.w: The launch targeted for late 2026 is the next step toward a crewed flight in 2027, an initial space-station module by 2028 and a longer-term independent human-spaceflight programme.

stories.h: South Koreans protest possible military involvement in Hormuz
stories.w: Seoul sent a fact-finding mission while saying no deployment decision had been made; Iran warned that participation in US operations would bring serious consequences.

stories.h: Australia introduces new offences targeting illicit tobacco networks
stories.w: The bill lowers evidentiary barriers for prosecuting importers, distributors and retailers and expands asset-seizure powers against a black market tied to organised crime.

stories.h: Australian reading and mathematics scores fall to record lows
stories.w: OECD data show the decline has lasted two decades, although students remain above the OECD average; low performance has increased while school absenteeism is unusually high.

stories.h: Australia and Solomon Islands reach an in-principle $980 million treaty
stories.w: The package would fund education, security and constituency projects as Canberra seeks to remain the Pacific country's preferred security partner amid strategic competition with China.

stories.h: Solomon Islands opposition alleges Australian interference over treaty talks
stories.w: A leaked diplomatic text sent during a leadership challenge triggered accusations that aid was being used to influence domestic politics; the deputy prime minister rejected that interpretation.
